text.en:
The following hospitals in Region VI are reclassified as follows:
Iloilo Provincial Hospital in the City of Iloilo to a medical center to be known as the Western Visayas Medical
Doña Corazon Montelibano Locsin Memorial Hospital in the City of Bacolod to a regional hospital to be
known as the Doña Corazon Locsin Montelibano Memorial Regional Hospital.

The amount needed for the implementation of this Act shall charged to the appropriations of the
Ministry of Health provided in Batas Pambansa Blg. 640. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the same
purpose shall be included in subsequent annual general appropriations acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
